title: Design System: SoFun Club — White + Curtain Crimson

display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Always uppercase, always Barlow Condensed. Latin only.

headline.purpose: Section titles. Always uppercase, Barlow Condensed. One per major section.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal titles, profile names. Sarabun 700. Sentence case.

body.purpose: Long-form descriptions, synopsis. Cap at 65-75ch. Sarabun 400.

label.purpose: Button text, nav text, badge text. Sarabun 700 UPPERCASE 0.1em tracking.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Default card/panel at idle on white surfaces.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover cards, important panels on white surfaces.

shadows.name: cta-press-white
shadows.purpose: Primary crimson CTA button hover on white pages.

shadows.name: cta-press-dark
shadows.purpose: Primary white CTA button hover on dark hero pages.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Card hover stripe reveal, modal entrance.

motion.name: ticker
motion.purpose: Ticker band scroll. Pause under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: particle
motion.purpose: Crimson particle drift on hero. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button (white page)
components.description: Crimson-on-white CTA. The single red element in the catalog.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">สำรองที่นั่ง</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c62419; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #c62419; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a1c13; border-color: #9a1c13; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(198,36,25,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(198,36,25,0.5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #cccccc; border-color: #cccccc; color: #888888; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Primary Button (dark hero)
components.description: White-on-dark CTA for the hero section.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary-dark">สำรองที่นั่ง</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { background: #ffffff; color: #09090f; border: 2px solid #ffffff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { background: #e8e8e8; border-color: #e8e8e8; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (white page)
components.description: Crimson ghost outline on white. Used alongside primary CTA.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary">ดูสคริปต์ทั้งหมด</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #c62419; border: 1px solid #c62419; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #c62419; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(198,36,25,0.5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Script Card (white register)
components.description: White-surface collectible card. Crimson left stripe reveals on hover.
components.html:
ฆาตกรรมบนเกาะ
สยองขวัญ · 6–12 คน · 3 ชั่วโมง
components.css: .ds-script-card { position: relative; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); overflow: hidden; } .ds-script-card-stripe { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: #c62419; transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-script-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(198,36,25,0.03); } .ds-script-card:hover .ds-script-card-stripe { transform: scaleY(1); }

components.name: Tag Chip (active)
components.description: Genre and atmosphere active filter tag.
components.html: สยองขวัญทั้งหมด
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); color: #555555; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-tag--active { background: rgba(198,36,25,0.12); color: #c62419; border-color: rgba(198,36,25,0.3); }

components.name: Text Input (light)
components.description: Search and form fields on white backgrounds. Crimson focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; color: #888888; pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); border-radius: 12px; color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; padding: 11px 16px 11px 44px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888888; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(198,36,25,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(198,36,25,0.08); }

components.name: Difficulty Badge
components.html: ยากมาก ยาก ปานกลาง ง่าย
components.css: .ds-diff { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 7px; font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; } .ds-diff--expert { background: #c62419; } .ds-diff--hard { background: #d97706; } .ds-diff--normal { background: #2563eb; } .ds-diff--easy { background: #16a34a; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: White nav with crimson bottom rule — the persistent structural accent.
components.html:
SoFun
หน้าแรกสคริปต์
components.css: .ds-top-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 60px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97); border-bottom: 2px solid #c62419; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 20px; color: #1a1a1a; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Sarabun', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #555555; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #c62419; background: rgba(198,36,25,0.08); } .ds-nav-link:hover:not(.ds-nav-link--active) { color: #1a1a1a; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

narrative.overview: SoFun Club is the cold open of a thriller. Two registers: near-black void for the hero and immersive sections, white paper for the catalog. A single binding accent — Curtain Crimson (#c62419) — marks decisive actions across both registers. Two colors. Maximum drama.
keyCharacteristics: Two-register structure: void near-black (#09090f) for hero/ticker, white (#ffffff) for catalog
Single accent: Curtain Crimson (#c62419) — ticker bg, nav bottom rule, CTAs, active filters, card hover stripe
Barlow Condensed uppercase display + Sarabun body across Thai / English / 中
Motion: crimson particles on dark hero, crimson ticker, crimson scroll progress bar
prefers-reduced-motion degrades all animations to instant transitions

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Curtain Crimson is the only accent hue. Every crimson element has a function: CTA, active state, ticker, progress bar. Never decorative.

rules.name: The Register Separation Rule
rules.body: White on dark, ink on white. Do not mix registers on the same surface.

rules.name: The Earned-Red Rule
rules.body: Crimson does not decorate. It marks: CTAs (act now), active states (you are here), ticker (announcement), progress bar (you are this far).

rules.name: The Latin-Only Display Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is Latin display only. Thai/中 uses Sarabun.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: No background-clip:text gradients. Emphasis from weight, size, and the single crimson accent only.

rules.name: The CTA-Glow-Only Rule
rules.body: Crimson glow shadows (rgba(198,36,25,...)) are reserved for primary CTA buttons in hover/active state only.

dos: Do use Curtain Crimson only where decisive action or emphasis is required: CTA, active state, ticker, progress bar, card hover stripe.
Do maintain the two-register structure — dark void hero, white catalog body.
Do apply the 3px crimson left stripe on script card hover.
Do use crimson focus rings on input fields.
Do keep the crimson bottom border on the top navigation.
Do pair Barlow Condensed uppercase with Sarabun body.
Do add prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for every animation.
Do keep LINE Green exclusively on the LINE auth affordance.
Do use chalk/parchment text (#e8e4dc) for body copy on the dark hero register.
donts: Don't introduce any second accent color alongside Curtain Crimson.
Don't use crimson as decorative fills or shadows on cards, modals, or nav backgrounds.
Don't use dripping-blood fonts, neon spider webs, skull motifs. Reference is Knives Out, not Spirit Halloween.
Don't use cream/sand/beige backgrounds on utility pages — white (#ffffff) is the catalog base.
Don't use Barlow Condensed for Thai or 中 display copy.
Don't add tracked uppercase eyebrows above every section.
Don't propagate the card crimson left-stripe to other cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't introduce boardgame-retailer bright primaries, esports neon-cyan, or RGB gradients.
